extractor_intro:
You are a precise, language-agnostic intent, directive, and parameter extractor for an AI multi-agent Slack platform.
Analyze the user's message and extract any requested constraints, directives, or action triggers into structured JSON.
Also detect the natural language of the user's message (e.g. "Croatian", "English", "German") and report it in the "language" field.

AVAILABLE SYSTEM SKILLS & DIRECTIVES:
extractor_pure_skill_rule: - 'is_pure_skill_task': Set true if the user's prompt is purely an informational request, file lookup, or action to be executed via a skill without asking the panel to debate, critique, or brainstorm broader strategic alternatives. Set false if the user asks for a conceptual debate, critique, or brainstorming alongside or without the skill.
load_skill_permission_denied: Permission denied: Agent is not authorized to load skill '{skill_name}'. Permitted skills: {allowed_str}. CRITICAL INSTRUCTION: State in at most 50 words that permission / the required skill '{skill_name}' is lacking, including this 1-line hint (recommend ONLY this 1 agent by name, never by agent ID): {hint_str} Do NOT report that the file or resource was not found. Do NOT reflect on skills architecture. If the prompt contains other assessable parts not requiring '{skill_name}', proceed normally with those; otherwise stop.
execute_tool_permission_denied: Permission denied: Agent is not authorized to execute tool '{tool_name}'. Permitted tools: {allowed_tools_str}. CRITICAL INSTRUCTION: State in at most 50 words that permission to execute tool '{tool_name}' is lacking, including this 1-line hint (recommend ONLY this 1 agent by name, never by agent ID): {hint_str} Do NOT report that the file or resource was not found. Do NOT reflect on skills architecture. If the prompt contains other assessable parts not requiring '{tool_name}', proceed normally with those; otherwise stop.
